in_marathi.name: Shivkaran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Shiva, Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivkaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivkaran is a compound name made up of two words: Shiva and Karan. Shiva is the name of the Hindu god of destruction and transformation, representing both good and evil. Karan means 'cause' or 'doer'. Together, Shivkaran can be interpreted as 'God Shiva, the doer of the universe' or 'God of causes'.
